flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/Notice/form/History.tsx (Court Application History tab commented out); ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsCourtCase (3 columns, no decision or status); ocmsadminprivateapi: no court application address check job. ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no code
note: Status Demo paid (50% of 75%); demo_remark: SFTP, code split, SFTP permission granted to the api App Service server. The story asks that when the officer decides to maintain the rejection, OCMS makes no update to the rejected record so it stays in the pool of notices eligible for court application address checks. There is no decision screen (OCMS24.20) and no court application address check pool or job (grep 'court application', 'maintain reject', 'rejected record' across the six repos = 0 code hits). The 'no update' condition is not violated only because no code exists; that is not an implementation: no decision can be chosen and no pool can be shown. Not rated Sesuai, consistent with OCMS24.20. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: No code for this story. Do not claim as done.

steps.step: The officer decides to maintain the rejection for a rejected record
steps.detail: No decision screen or option; the 'Court Application History' tab is commented out (History.tsx:170-172). Same as OCMS24.20.

steps.step: OCMS makes no update to the rejected record
steps.detail: No handler for a maintain-rejection decision; OcmsCourtCase (lines 24-31) has no decision column. The record is 'unchanged' only because no code exists, not because of logic. Not rated Sesuai.

steps.step: The record stays in the pool of notices eligible for court application address checks
steps.detail: No job or query for a court application address check pool was found; the only related item is the ICMS SFTP config (sftp-prod.properties:87-90) with no consumer. cannot verify from repo whether such a pool exists outside the six repos.
